title: GLG Relaunches myGLG Client Platform with Agentic AI Tools
summary: GLG unveiled a reimagined myGLG client platform built around a new suite of AI-powered tools, positioning the platform to let clients apply human expertise at greater speed and scale. GLG framed the relaunch as a move toward research that is 'both human-led and AI-augmented,' extending its incumbent expert-network model into agentic workflows.
whyItMatters: GLG is the largest expert network by scale, so its shift to an AI-augmented client platform signals that agentic workflows are becoming table stakes for incumbents rather than a differentiator owned by technology-first challengers.
